caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted head resembling an animal, possibly a feline or simian, with exaggerated features. The head is seen in a three-quarter frontal view and appears to be made out of a material that mimics wood or stone, indicated by the brown and gray shading with visible texture lines and cracks running across the surface. The figure features two large, rounded eyes with circular pupils, pronounced eyelids, a broad and prominent nose with two large nostrils, and a wide mouth with a slightly protruding lower jaw. The ears are rough and textured, extending out at an angle from the head, and the areas around the cheeks and under the chin have carved lines suggesting fur or hair. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional elements or details surrounding the head. The shading is carefully rendered, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Cat Head Gargoyle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
